posts.title: Bingley Analogue
posts.description: This Saturday saw the first (of many, I hope) Bingley Climate Café upstairs from Hedgehog Organics in the Feel Good Hub studio space. The initiative of Chris Grayston, inspired by the local community showings of "The People's Emergency Briefing", it was lovely to see a nice big group of people turn out to discuss how we might respond, locally, to the challenge of climate change effects. posts.title: The People's Emergency Briefing - a response
posts.description: So, firstly, what is The People’s Emergency Briefing? In November 2025, the National Emergency Briefing brought leading experts together in Westminster to present the evidence on the climate and nature crisis to politicians and other influential people. The People’s Emergency Briefing is a film based on that event, now being taken into communities across the UK for public screenings and discussion
